images.seen: Africa and the Middle East at the end of 2020: Seleka drawn over eastern CAR, a messy Western Sahara (west drawn as SADR land, Dakhla drawn the wrong way round), Houthis in the north-west; no other gross error.
Western Sahara: Laayoune and Smara drawn as SADR land occupied by Morocco (right), Dakhla drawn as Moroccan land occupied by the SADR (reversed), the Free Zone drawn as Moroccan and contested.

Sudan with the RSF holding Darfur and contested patches in the centre, Somaliland with a Somali-coloured Las Anod area, STC and Houthis in Yemen: plausible; 2024-keyframe border slivers (Mauritania/Mali, Zambia) too thin to see.
Tigray: whole region drawn as TPLF/Ethiopia contested stripes, three ownerless cells, no Eritrean occupation of the north (3 Eritrean cells drawn as occupied by Ethiopia); left, pages not reopened.
Crimea and all of Zaporizhzhia and Kherson drawn as plain Ukrainian land since 2022: wrong. The compiler closed the single Russia-Ukraine occupation relation at the first occupation_end of 2022.
Crimea, left-bank Kherson and about 70 percent of Zaporizhzhia now hatched as occupied by Russia; Ukrainian north of Zaporizhzhia and the Kherson right bank plain.
Western Sahara: the Moroccan-held west is SADR land occupied by Morocco throughout, the Free Zone contested; Morocco proper plain.

issues.what: Russian occupation of Crimea, Sevastopol and the occupied south (Kherson left bank, Zaporizhzhia) dropped in 2022: the compiler closes the whole Russia-Ukraine occupation relation at the first occupation_end (Kyiv area, April 2022), so about 237 cells (Crimea 83, south 154) were drawn plain Ukrainian 2022-2026 (the dossier's own ukraine_2024 keyframe text says they stay occupied).

Western Sahara: the gazetteer's 'W. Sahara' is only the Free Zone (331 cells); the anchor gives Morocco the Free Zone (330 cells) and 226 Dakhla cells with the SADR as occupier of Moroccan-held Dakhla, and 47 Dakhla cells as SADR direct. Laayoune and Smara were already right after the upstream patches (p1970-p1979).

Mexico holds 93 US cells (New Mexico 45, Texas 34, Colorado 14) along the Rio Grande from 2009: mexico /ledger/9 'six islands' resolves to the Rio Grande plus 5 km. The 2024 keyframes undo it (mexico -98, usa +96).
84 ownerless cells inside Iraq (Salah ad-Din 59, Diyala 18, Ninawa 5+) from 2018-2019 (islamic-state keyframes end without events returning them) until Iraq's 2024 keyframe.

Kyrgyz-Uzbek frontier: uzbekistan /ledger/4 (2022, 156 km2) is read as a one-cell band along the whole 1,314 km border: 34 Uzbek cells drawn Kyrgyz 2022-2023; /ledger/5 (2024, Barak enclave) the same, and the 2024 Uzbek keyframe then threw 35 Kyrgyz cells to nobody (a ring of ownerless cells from 2024 to the end of the data).

Mali holds all 43 cells of Burkina Faso's Oudalan province 1986-2023 (mali-federation /ledger/6 gives 'the western portion of the Agacher Strip' as the whole province); Burkina's 2024 keyframe takes it back (conflict 43 cell-years). Page not opened (budget); the cause is in p1980-p1989.

Tigray War: 80 Tigray cells are ownerless at the end of 2023 (the TPLF dissolution drops the cells outside its keyframe to nobody; Ethiopia's keyframe takes them in 2024); the Eritrean occupation of the north is 3 Eritrean cells drawn as occupied by Ethiopia (roles reversed); the Weldiya events (ethiopia /ledger/25 and /28, tigray-people-s-liberation-front /ledger/4 and /7) are skipped. The Weldiya events run August to December 2021 and never show in a year-end map.
Somaliland loses the Las Anod area (151 cells) to SSC-Khatumo in 2023: no dossier, so it is ownerless until Somalia's 2024 keyframe takes it.
Central African Republic: Seleka holds the north and east until 2021, then 884 cells are contested until the end of 2024 and pass to the CAR; a dossier design choice with sources.
Sudan: RSF holds Darfur from 2023 with contested patches in the centre; the Chad and Libya conflicts are Darfur border cells the RSF wins by size.

2024-keyframe border slivers: Mauritania takes a 49-cell strip of Mali along the border, Zambia 23 cells of Angola and Zimbabwe, Senegal, Guinea, Cote d'Ivoire and Burkina move a few cells each; thin strips between Cliopatria's 2024 outline and the gazetteer, no event behind them.

Caucasus 2020: the Armenia-Azerbaijan occupation relation closes whole at the first occupation_end (October 2020) but every district is back by 1 December, so the end of 2020 is right; Artsakh keeps 7 cells until September 2023.

Packet snaps for South Africa (Transkei, Venda, Ciskei), Belize, Sierra Leone (RUF band) and Denmark disappear once the other windows' patches (p1970-p1979, p1990-p1999) are applied; nothing to do here.

dossier_requests.what: a new dossier for SSC-Khatumo (the Dhulbahante administration of Las Anod, 2023, later the North Eastern State of Somalia)
dossier_requests.why: somaliland /ledger/4 and /5 hand Las Anod and the Sool, Sanaag and Togdheer lands to a counterpart with no dossier, so 151 cells are ownerless in 2023 and pass to Somalia only through its 2024 keyframe; page cited by the somaliland dossier, not opened by me.

dossier_requests.what: /ledger/6 (1986, 'the western portion of the Agacher Strip'): region is the whole Oudalan province (43 cells); the page gives Mali the western part of a strip of about one cell.
dossier_requests.why: Mali holds Burkina Faso's Oudalan from 1986 to 2023 and the 2024 Burkina keyframe then takes it back; the fix belongs in p1980-p1989 (a loss to Burkina Faso or a smaller region).

problems: tool: 'compile_dossiers.py --trial p2020-p2029' fails with FileNotFoundError (the draft is never written): a trial runs to min(window end, LAST_YEAR=2026), so on_window_end(2029) is not in the window_ends set it passes to comp.run, although run() would call it after the loop. I ran a private copy in /tmp with one change (window_ends also holds trial['to']); the real tool is untouched. Every other window ending after 2026 would fail the same way; --check-patch works.

compiler: relation_end closes the whole relation (key occupation, did, counterpart) whatever the region of the *_end event. Any pair with several partial occupations or contests loses all of them at the first end. Russia-Ukraine fixed by events/0; other windows' pairs with partial ends (Kherson-style) may be affected.

anchor: the Jan-1 2020 anchor still shows the Free Zone as Moroccan and Dakhla reversed (my events apply during 2020, month 1-2, so only year-end maps change). The root cause is in the 1976-1991 events (the gazetteer's 'W. Sahara' resolves only to the Free Zone, so morocco /ledger/25 and the sahrawi 1976 found reach only the Free Zone): p1980-p1989 or p1990-p1999 should give the Free Zone and Dakhla to the SADR (Morocco occupying Dakhla) from 1991.

anchor: Mexico's 93 US cells (events/3) come from mexico /ledger/9 of 2009 (p2000-p2009); Iraq's 84 ownerless cells (events/4) from the islamic-state keyframe snaps of 2018-2019 (p2010-p2019); Oudalan from 1986 (p1980-p1989). If those windows patch them, events/3 and events/4 are no-ops (they move only land that Mexico holds in the US shape, and only ownerless cells), and nothing breaks.

pattern: border_band width 1 is used for sub-cell transfers (uzbekistan /ledger/4 and /5) and moves a whole border strip; other dossiers may do the same (check dossiers that gain or lose 'a border_band' for an area under 1 cell).
events/3 and events/4 are dated 2020 (inside the window) but repair earlier errors; no entry reaches into another window.

Mauritania / SADR: with the SADR now holding Dakhla the 2024 keyframe conflict mauritania / sahrawi-arab-democratic-republic is 13 cell-years (SADR wins; it was Morocco's 12 against Mauritania): a one-cell border strip, not touched.
hierarchy: no wrong row seen (one row active after 2020, kurdistan-region under republic-of-iraq, 2005-2026).
